function: system, p. 7: learned CSI feedback (deep-clustering labels, area 2) over a measured AAV-to-ground link with one omnidirectional antenna at the TX and one at the RX, and no RIS.
notes: Excluded as system (first applicable code). The learned method, an autoencoder plus K-means deep clustering (pp. 4-5), builds semantic databases of measured CIRs so that only a database label is fed back instead of the full CSI (pp. 2-3): a CSI compression and feedback function, area 2. Scenario identification with a BPNN taken from [24] is only the downstream ISAC task used for validation, identical for both schemes (p. 6), so the function check passes. p. 7: "The AAV TX features an FPGA-based transmission unit paired with an omnidirectional antenna" and the ground station includes "an omnidirectional antenna"; Table I (p. 7): 3.6 GHz, 61.44 MHz. No RIS. The learned function is not resource, power, or beam control, so the work is not area 6 and the NTN exception for single-antenna links does not apply. For the reviewer: if the learned function were read as scenario identification (the main metric is identification accuracy, p. 8), the first code would be function instead; both readings exclude.
